title.zh-CN: 突发左侧肢体瘫痪 · 12岁男孩

summary.zh-CN: 12岁男孩左边的胳膊和腿突然不能动了，约6小时后被送来，呼吸很快，四肢的脉搏也对不上：从第一个小时一直跟到他记录在案的结局。
summary.en: A 12-year-old boy is brought in about six hours after his left arm and leg suddenly stopped moving, breathing fast and with pulses that do not add up: follow him from the first hour to the end of his recorded course.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 把左侧中枢性面舌瘫、左侧偏瘫和Babinski征定位到右侧大脑半球，并从左桡动脉摸不到、只有右侧能测到血压、双侧股动脉搏动差和下肢发凉，认出其他动脉床同时缺血。
learningOutcomes.en: Localise a left central facial and tongue palsy, left hemiplegia and a Babinski sign to the right hemisphere, and recognise from an absent left radial pulse, a blood pressure measurable only on the right, poor femoral pulses and cool legs that other arterial beds are ischaemic at the same time.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 为发病约6小时的疑似卒中患儿安排第一个小时：1小时内完成头颅和血管影像（RCPCH 2017；AHA/ASA 2026），立即请儿童卒中团队评估取栓，吸氧使SpO₂ > 92%，测血糖、抽血查凝血、禁食——并说明为什么已不能静脉溶栓。
learningOutcomes.en: Run the first hour for a child with suspected stroke six hours after onset: brain and vessel imaging within the hour (RCPCH 2017; AHA/ASA 2026), the paediatric stroke team called now about thrombectomy, oxygen to SpO₂ > 92%, glucose, bloods with clotting and nil by mouth — and state why IV thrombolysis is no longer an option.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 解释为什么急性肢体缺血推荐的肝素（ESVS 2020）在急性卒中患儿身上要等头颅影像之后，以及当栓子来源是心脏肿瘤时，抗凝能预防什么、不能预防什么（AHA/ASA 2019；AHA/ASA 2021）。
learningOutcomes.en: Explain why heparin, recommended for acute limb ischaemia (ESVS 2020), waits for brain imaging in a child with an acute stroke, and what anticoagulation can and cannot prevent when the embolic source is a cardiac tumour (AHA/ASA 2019; AHA/ASA 2021).

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 把突入二尖瓣口的有蒂左房团块同时看作栓子来源和左心充盈的梗阻，当天请心脏外科，并说明卒中团队与心脏外科怎样一起定手术时机（AHA/ASA 2021 §5.6）。
learningOutcomes.en: Interpret a pedunculated left-atrial mass that prolapses into the mitral orifice as both an embolic source and an obstruction, refer for excision the same day, and describe how the stroke team and the cardiac surgeons set its timing together (AHA/ASA 2021 §5.6).

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 对肢体缺血后新出现的小腿肿痛，先排查骨筋膜室综合征——临床体征、拿不准时测压、确诊后2小时内切开减压（ESVS 2020）——不给缺血的腿加压。
learningOutcomes.en: Assess new swollen, painful calves after limb ischaemia for compartment syndrome first — clinical signs, pressures when unclear, fasciotomy within two hours of the diagnosis (ESVS 2020) — and never compress ischaemic legs.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 为切除黏液瘤后的儿童制定随访：超声心动图复查复发、评估Carney综合征并做遗传咨询，以及神经康复（Correa 2015）。
learningOutcomes.en: Plan follow-up after excision of a myxoma in a child: echocardiographic surveillance for recurrence, assessment for Carney complex with genetic counselling, and neurorehabilitation (Correa 2015).

notes.zh-CN: 依据中华儿科杂志2013年发表的单篇病例报告改编。本版（1.1.0）的患者事实全部沿用1.0.0版从报告中提取的内容——12岁男孩，突发左侧肢体瘫痪6小时，发病前无外伤，发病时呼吸急促，最初左上下肢无力、右侧能动；左侧中枢性面舌瘫、左上下肢肌力0级、Babinski征阳性、右侧肌力正常；左桡动脉未触及、双股动脉搏动差、下肢皮温低，右侧血压110/70 mmHg、左侧测不出；呼吸40次/分、双肺广泛湿啰音；头颅MRI及血管成像示双侧多发脑异常信号（右侧为主）、右大脑中动脉中远段狭窄闭塞、左锁骨下动脉闭塞；下肢血管检查示双下肢重度缺血频谱、左腘静脉及股腘动脉血栓，后续血管成像示多处动脉闭塞；超声心动图示左房面房间隔及二尖瓣附近5.5 cm×3.5 cm有蒂团块（蒂约1.6 cm），舒张期部分突入二尖瓣口，轻中度反流；住院第3天双侧小腿明显肿痛；先行支持、抗凝等治疗，住院40天后出院，约1个月后切除左房肿物，病理为左房黏液瘤（各栓塞物成分未提供）；此后左上肢恢复，左下肢肌力近端Ⅴ-级、远端Ⅲ级，超声未见复发——尚未对照原文全文核对。患者为化名，医院和日期已去除。分阶段设计、各阶段的时间安排、决策、处置选项、评分、医护人员和家属说出的担心（教学设定，不增加临床事实）均为教学设计；未记录的内容（其他生命体征、意识和言语、化验、心电图、胸片、影像时间与细节、治疗药物与剂量、手术细节、随访时长）保持未知。1.0.0版中英文有几处不一致（小腿“明显”肿痛、抗凝与抗栓、血管成像与血管造影、超声与超声心动图、Ⅴ-级与接近Ⅴ级），均按原样保留并列入待核实。
notes.en: Adapted from a single case report published in the Chinese Journal of Pediatrics in 2013. Every patient fact in this version (1.1.0) is one extracted from the report for version 1.0.0 — a 12-year-old boy with six hours of sudden left-sided paralysis, no injury beforehand and fast breathing at onset, at first weakness of the left arm and leg with the right side still moving; a left central facial and tongue palsy, power grade 0 in the left limbs, a positive Babinski sign and normal power on the right; no palpable left radial pulse, poor femoral pulses, cool legs, a blood pressure of 110/70 mmHg on the right and unmeasurable on the left; a respiratory rate of 40/min with widespread crackles over both lungs; brain MRI and vascular imaging with multiple abnormal signals on both sides (predominantly right), mid-to-distal right middle cerebral artery stenosis/occlusion and left subclavian occlusion; lower-limb vascular studies with severe ischaemic waveforms in both legs and thrombus in the left popliteal vein and the femoropopliteal artery, and later vascular imaging with multiple arterial occlusions; an echocardiogram with a pedunculated 5.5 × 3.5 cm mass (stalk about 1.6 cm) on the left-atrial side of the atrial septum near the mitral valve, partly prolapsing into the mitral orifice in diastole, with mild-to-moderate regurgitation; both calves obviously swollen and painful on hospital day 3; supportive and anticoagulant treatment first, discharge after 40 days in hospital and resection of the left atrial mass about a month later, with pathology of left atrial myxoma (the composition of the individual emboli not provided); afterwards recovery of the left arm, left-leg power V− proximally and III distally, and no recurrence on ultrasound — and none has yet been checked against the full article. The patient has a pseudonym; hospitals and dates are removed. The phases and their timing, the decisions, intervention options, scoring, staff and the relative's voiced worry (a teaching device that adds no clinical fact) are teaching design; what is not recorded (other vital signs, conscious level and speech, laboratory results, ECG, chest X-ray, the timing and detail of the imaging, the drugs and doses, the operation, the length of follow-up) stays unknown. Where version 1.0.0's Chinese and English differ (the calves 'obviously' swollen, anticoagulant or antithrombotic, vascular imaging or angiography, ultrasound or echocardiography, grade V− or near grade V), both readings are kept and listed under To verify.

chiefComplaint.en: Sudden paralysis of the left arm and leg for six hours

triageNote.zh-CN: 12岁男孩，由家属陪同送来。约6小时前左边胳膊和腿突然不能动，发病前没有受伤。他呼吸很快；左侧量不出血压。
triageNote.en: 12-year-old boy brought in by a relative. About six hours ago his left arm and leg suddenly stopped moving; he had not been injured beforehand. He is breathing fast, and no blood pressure can be obtained on his left side.

tags.en: No blood pressure on the left

personality.zh-CN: 12岁男孩，左边的胳膊和腿突然动不了，躺在床上呼吸很快，话很少，只用几个字回答；经过主要由陪他来的家属讲。
personality.en: A 12-year-old whose left arm and leg have suddenly stopped working. Lying in bed and breathing fast, he says very little and answers in a few words; the relative who came with him tells most of the story.

speechStyle.zh-CN: 孩子说话很短；家属用日常口语，不用医学术语，不知道就直说，不替医生下结论。
speechStyle.en: The boy speaks in very short phrases; his relative uses everyday words and no medical terms, says plainly when they do not know something, and draws no medical conclusions.

openingLine.zh-CN: 我左边的胳膊和腿……一下子就动不了了。
openingLine.en: My left arm and leg… they just stopped moving.

fallbackUnknown.en: I'm not sure about that, doctor.

concerns.zh-CN: 我的胳膊和腿还能好吗？
concerns.en: Will my arm and leg get better?

actingNotes.zh-CN: 家属回答病史；直接问孩子的问题由孩子用几个字回答，他呼吸很快。只讲病例里有的事：大约6小时前突然起病，发病前没有受伤，这次发病时呼吸很急，一开始是左边胳膊和腿没劲、右边还能动；到了住院第3天，孩子说两边小腿都明显肿了、疼。以前的心脏情况和检查、平时用药、过敏、家族史、疫苗、以前的病和手术、上学和运动、发病时有没有人在场、有没有抽搐或头痛，都如实说不知道，绝不编造；不提任何检查结果。
actingNotes.en: The relative gives the history; questions put to the boy he answers himself in a few words, breathing fast. Say only what the case holds: sudden onset about six hours ago, no injury beforehand, very fast breathing when it came on, at first the left arm and leg weak with the right side still moving; on day 3 of the admission the boy says both calves are obviously swollen and sore. His heart and any heart tests before this, regular medicines, allergies, family history, vaccinations, past illnesses and operations, school and sport, whether anyone saw the onset, and any fit or headache are honestly not known — never invent them, and never mention a test result.

persona.zh-CN: 陪他来医院的家属；是哪位亲属没有记录，不要另加设定。着急但配合，用日常的话回答，只讲自己看到的或医生告诉过的事；不知道就直说，不替医生下结论。
persona.en: The family member who came in with him — which relative is not recorded, so add none. Worried but cooperative; answers in everyday words, says only what they saw or were told, says so when they do not know, and draws no medical conclusions.

dose.zh-CN: 按儿童抗凝方案根据体重静脉输注，用抗Xa或APTT监测；前提是头颅影像已排除出血、已知血小板和凝血情况，并经卒中团队同意。
dose.en: Weight-based IV infusion per the paediatric anticoagulation protocol, monitored by anti-Xa level or APTT — only once brain imaging has excluded haemorrhage, platelets and clotting are known, and the stroke team agrees.

harm.zh-CN: 头颅影像还没有排除出血。急性卒中患儿在影像之前抗凝，可能让缺血灶变成出血：RCPCH 2017 在确诊动脉缺血性卒中、且没有脑实质出血等禁忌时才给阿司匹林，病因在心脏时由多学科在抗血小板和抗凝之间选择；AHA/ASA 2019 声明把很大的急性梗死列为抗凝的相对禁忌。ESVS 2020 建议急性肢体缺血用肝素，但他同时有急性卒中，先看脑。
harm.en: Brain imaging has not yet excluded haemorrhage. Anticoagulating a child with an acute stroke before imaging can turn ischaemia into a bleed: RCPCH 2017 gives aspirin only once arterial ischaemic stroke is diagnosed and contraindications such as parenchymal haemorrhage are absent, and has a team choose between antiplatelet and anticoagulant when the cause is cardiac, and the AHA/ASA 2019 statement lists very large acute infarcts as a relative contraindication to anticoagulation. ESVS 2020 advises heparin for acute limb ischaemia, but with an acute stroke the brain is imaged first.

response.zh-CN: 肝素开始输注。本病例记录他接受过抗凝等治疗，但没有记录药物、剂量、开始时间和监测结果；不模拟其效果。
response.en: The heparin infusion is running. The case records anticoagulant treatment among his care but not the drug, dose, start or monitoring, and does not simulate its effect.

harm.zh-CN: 他到院时已发病约6小时，超出了 RCPCH 2017 和 AHA/ASA 2026 指南儿童推荐中可以考虑静脉溶栓的4.5小时时间窗；时间窗外溶栓只增加出血风险，没有已证实的获益。
harm.en: He arrived about six hours after onset — outside the 4.5-hour window within which RCPCH 2017 and the paediatric recommendation of the AHA/ASA 2026 guideline allow IV thrombolysis to be considered; outside it, thrombolysis adds bleeding risk without proven benefit.

response.zh-CN: 阿替普酶已给。本病例没有记录他接受过溶栓，也不模拟其效果。
response.en: Alteplase has been given. No thrombolysis is recorded for him, and its effect is not simulated.

name.en: Catheter-directed thrombolysis of the leg arteries

harm.zh-CN: 近两个月内确定的脑血管事件（包括TIA）是急性肢体缺血溶栓的绝对禁忌（ESVS 2020，表5）；他正处在急性卒中期，溶栓可能引起颅内出血。儿童急性肢体缺血以肝素为主，保守治疗无效时才考虑溶栓或开放手术（ESVS 2020）。
harm.en: An established cerebrovascular event (including a TIA) within the last two months is an absolute contraindication to thrombolysis for acute limb ischaemia (ESVS 2020, Table 5); with an acute stroke it risks bleeding into the brain. In children, heparin is the mainstay for acute limb ischaemia, with thrombolysis or open surgery considered only when it fails (ESVS 2020).

response.zh-CN: 导管溶栓的申请已发出。本病例没有记录这项治疗，也不模拟其效果。
response.en: The request for catheter-directed thrombolysis is made. This treatment is not recorded for him, and its effect is not simulated.

dose.zh-CN: 今天就请心脏外科医生来床旁看他，并与卒中团队一起根据头颅影像（有无出血、梗死大小）商定手术时机。
dose.en: Ask the cardiac surgeons to see him at the bedside today, and agree the timing of any operation with the stroke team from the brain imaging (any haemorrhage, the size of the infarcts).

response.zh-CN: 心脏外科已接到会诊申请。是否手术、什么时候手术，记录在病例后面的部分。
response.en: The cardiac surgeons have the referral. Whether and when he was operated on is recorded later in the case.

name.zh-CN: 立即床旁评估双小腿有无骨筋膜室综合征
name.en: Urgent bedside assessment of both calves for compartment syndrome

dose.zh-CN: 与血管外科医生一起检查：小腿张力、被动牵拉痛、感觉和活动、足部循环；临床判断不清时测骨筋膜室压力；一旦确诊立即切开减压（ESVS 2020）。
dose.en: With the vascular surgeon: compartment tension, pain on passive stretch, sensation and movement, and the circulation of the feet; measure compartment pressures if the clinical picture is unclear, and decompress at once if the diagnosis is made (ESVS 2020).

response.zh-CN: 血管外科医生正在床旁检查他的小腿。本病例没有记录是否诊断了骨筋膜室综合征，也没有记录是否做了切开减压。
response.en: The vascular surgeon is examining his calves now. The case does not record whether compartment syndrome was diagnosed or a fasciotomy done.

name.en: Elevate the legs and fit compression stockings

harm.zh-CN: 他的下肢缺血（股动脉搏动差、皮温低）：加压和抬高会进一步降低灌注压，还可能掩盖或加重骨筋膜室综合征。NICE NG89（2018，针对16岁以上人群，原则适用）规定，疑似或确诊外周动脉疾病者不使用抗栓弹力袜；小腿肿痛要先排查骨筋膜室综合征（ESVS 2020）。
harm.en: His legs are ischaemic (poor femoral pulses, cool to touch): compression and elevation lower perfusion pressure further and can mask or worsen compartment syndrome. NICE NG89 (2018; for over-16s, the principle applies) says anti-embolism stockings are not offered to people with suspected or proven peripheral arterial disease; swollen, painful calves are checked for compartment syndrome first (ESVS 2020).

response.zh-CN: 腿已抬高，弹力袜已穿上。本病例没有记录这样处理，也不模拟其效果。
response.en: The legs are raised and the stockings are on. This is not recorded for him, and its effect is not simulated.

name.zh-CN: 转介儿童神经康复（物理治疗、作业治疗、言语和吞咽治疗）
name.en: Refer to paediatric neurorehabilitation (physiotherapy, occupational, speech and swallowing therapy)

dose.zh-CN: 尽早开始康复评估和治疗，和家人一起定目标。
dose.en: Start rehabilitation assessment and therapy early, and set the goals together with his family.

response.zh-CN: 康复团队已接到转介。本病例没有描述他的康复过程。
response.en: The rehabilitation team has the referral. His rehabilitation is not described in the case.

name.zh-CN: 安排长期随访并转遗传门诊
name.en: Arrange long-term follow-up and a genetics referral

dose.zh-CN: 定期复查超声心动图；转遗传门诊评估有无遗传性病因，并决定家人是否需要检查。
dose.en: Regular echocardiograms, and a genetics referral to look for an inherited cause and decide whether relatives need checking.

response.zh-CN: 随访和遗传门诊转介已安排。本病例记录了随访时的超声结果，但没有记录随访间隔、遗传学评估或家族筛查。
response.en: Follow-up and the genetics referral are arranged. The case records a follow-up ultrasound result but not the interval, any genetic assessment or family screening.

title.zh-CN: 弄清这次是怎么发生的

hint.zh-CN: 什么时候开始、怎样开始？哪一边？之前有没有受伤？呼吸怎么样？他以前的心脏和家里人的情况知道吗？
hint.en: When and how did it start, on which side, after any injury? How is he breathing — and what is known about his heart and his family?

title.en: Examine him and connect the findings

hint.zh-CN: 神经系统之外，还要摸哪里、量哪里？两侧一样吗？什么情况能同时影响这么多地方？
hint.en: Beyond the neurology, what else do you feel and measure — and is it the same on both sides? What could affect so many places at once?

hint.zh-CN: 距发病已经多久？哪些治疗还有时间窗？谁需要现在就知道？在排除什么之前，哪些药不能用？
hint.en: How long since onset, and which treatments still have a window? Who needs to know now — and which drugs must wait until something has been excluded?

title.zh-CN: 读懂首批结果，据此行动
title.en: Read the first results and act on them

hint.zh-CN: 影像显示了哪些部位？来源在哪里，需要什么处理？由谁来决定、多快？
hint.en: Which territories does the imaging show? Where is the source, and what does it need — from whom, and how soon?

hint.zh-CN: 肢体缺血之后小腿又肿又痛，最怕的是什么？怎么查、谁来查、多快？
hint.en: After limb ischaemia, what is the danger in swollen, painful calves — how is it checked, by whom, and how fast?

title.en: Follow him to the end of his course

hint.zh-CN: 病理说明了什么、没说明什么？他和家人以后需要什么随访？报告记录的经过和今天的做法有什么不同？
hint.en: What does the pathology establish, and what not? What follow-up do he and his family need — and how does the recorded course compare with today's practice?

prompt.zh-CN: 这个12岁男孩约6小时前突然左侧偏瘫，发病前没有外伤。他呼吸40次/分，双肺广泛湿啰音；左桡动脉摸不到，双侧股动脉搏动差，下肢发凉；右侧血压110/70 mmHg，左侧测不出。哪一种解释最能把这些发现统一起来？
prompt.en: This 12-year-old developed a sudden left hemiplegia about six hours ago, with no injury beforehand. He is breathing at 40/min with widespread crackles over both lungs; the left radial pulse cannot be felt, both femoral pulses are poor and his legs are cool; the blood pressure is 110/70 mmHg on the right and unmeasurable on the left. Which explanation best brings these findings together?

need.zh-CN: 先问清起病经过和呼吸情况，并检查神经系统、四肢脉搏、生命体征和双肺。
need.en: First establish how it began and how he is breathing, and examine his neurology, his pulses, his vital signs and his lungs.

text.zh-CN: 同一来源的栓子从左心同时堵住了几处动脉——脑、左上肢和双下肢；双肺湿啰音提示这个病变还在阻碍左心充盈
text.en: Emboli from one source in the left heart blocking several arteries at once — brain, left arm and both legs — with the crackles suggesting the same lesion obstructs left-heart filling

feedback.zh-CN: 对。几处供血区域同时缺血——右侧大脑半球（左侧偏瘫、面舌瘫）、左上肢（脉搏消失、血压测不出）和双下肢——最符合同一来源的栓塞，突然起病、发病前无外伤也支持这一点；快速呼吸加双肺湿啰音提示左心充盈受阻、肺静脉淤血。下一步用超声心动图找来源，用头颅和血管影像看脑（AHA/ASA 2019 声明：卒中患儿通常都做超声心动图）。
feedback.en: Right. Ischaemia in several territories at once — the right hemisphere (left hemiplegia, facial and tongue palsy), the left arm (no pulse, no measurable pressure) and both legs — fits emboli from a single source, and the sudden onset without injury supports it; fast breathing with crackles over both lungs suggests impaired left-heart filling with pulmonary venous congestion. Echocardiography looks for the source and brain and vessel imaging for the damage (the AHA/ASA 2019 statement: children with stroke typically have an echocardiogram).

text.zh-CN: 局灶性脑动脉病——此前健康的儿童发生动脉缺血性卒中的常见原因；肢体发凉和肺部的表现都能用他卧床不动、紧张害怕和呼吸急促来解释
text.en: Focal cerebral arteriopathy, a common cause of arterial stroke in previously healthy children, with the cool limbs and the chest findings explained by lying still, fear and fast breathing

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。局灶性脑动脉病只累及颅内动脉，解释不了左上肢脉搏消失、左侧血压测不出和双下肢缺血；卧床和紧张不会让一侧桡动脉摸不到。几处供血区域同时出问题，应先找共同的栓子来源。
feedback.en: No. Focal cerebral arteriopathy affects intracranial arteries only; it cannot explain a pulseless left arm with no measurable pressure and ischaemic legs, and lying still or fear do not abolish a radial pulse. Several territories at once call for a shared embolic source first.

text.zh-CN: 一次没人看到的癫痫发作之后出现Todd麻痹；呼吸急促、湿啰音和下肢发凉都是发作后的表现
text.en: An unwitnessed seizure followed by Todd's paresis, with the fast breathing, the crackles and the cool legs all part of the post-ictal state

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。Todd麻痹是排除性诊断，也解释不了一侧脉搏消失、血压测不出这样的局部动脉阻塞体征。有没有抽搐本病例并不知道；局灶性神经缺损要按卒中立即做影像。
feedback.en: No. Todd's paresis is a diagnosis of exclusion and cannot explain focal arterial signs such as a pulseless arm with no measurable pressure. Whether he had a seizure is not known; a focal deficit is imaged at once as a stroke.

text.zh-CN: 大动脉炎（如Takayasu动脉炎）几个月来慢慢让锁骨下动脉、股动脉和脑动脉变窄，这一次终于表现出来
text.en: A large-vessel vasculitis such as Takayasu arteritis, slowly narrowing the subclavian, femoral and cerebral arteries over months until it finally declared itself

feedback.zh-CN: 不是最佳解释。大动脉炎确实会让脉搏减弱、两侧血压不一致，但通常逐渐起病；本病例也没有记录发热、乏力等全身症状（这是未知，不等于没有）。突然出现的多部位缺血加上肺部湿啰音，更指向栓塞和心脏。
feedback.en: Not the best explanation. A large-vessel vasculitis does weaken pulses and make the two arms' pressures unequal, but it usually comes on gradually, and no systemic symptoms are recorded (unknown, not absent). Sudden ischaemia in several places with crackles in the lungs points to emboli and the heart.

text.zh-CN: 休克使四肢冰冷，脑灌注不足造成分水岭梗死
text.en: Shock with cold peripheries, and a watershed stroke from low cerebral perfusion

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。右侧血压110/70 mmHg不支持休克；左上肢脉搏消失、血压测不出而右侧正常，这种不对称说明是局部动脉阻塞，而不是心输出量降低。
feedback.en: No. A blood pressure of 110/70 mmHg on the right argues against shock, and the asymmetry — a pulseless left arm with no measurable pressure beside a normal right — means a focal arterial occlusion, not low cardiac output.

prompt.zh-CN: 他到院时距发病约6小时。第一个小时里应该做什么？
prompt.en: He has arrived about six hours after onset. What should the first hour hold?

need.zh-CN: 先问清起病时间，并检查神经系统和四肢脉搏。
need.en: First establish when it began, and examine his neurology and his pulses.

text.zh-CN: 1小时内完成头颅和血管影像（首选MRI/MRA，做不到就做CT/CTA），立即请儿童卒中团队评估能否取栓；吸氧使SpO₂ > 92%，查血糖，抽血含凝血，禁食，请血管外科急会诊；不溶栓，排除出血前不用抗栓药
text.en: Brain and vessel imaging within the hour (MRI/MRA, or CT/CTA if MRI cannot be done promptly) and the paediatric stroke team called now about thrombectomy; oxygen to SpO₂ > 92%, glucose, bloods with clotting, nil by mouth and an urgent vascular review — no thrombolysis, and no antithrombotic until haemorrhage is excluded

feedback.zh-CN: 对。到院1小时内完成头颅和血管影像（RCPCH 2017：CT加CTA，1小时内能做MRI时可首选MRI；AHA/ASA 2026：首选MRI/MRA，不能及时做时用CT）。他已发病约6小时，超出静脉溶栓的4.5小时时间窗；但AHA/ASA 2026指南对6岁以上大血管闭塞的儿童，在6小时内、或24小时内影像提示有可挽救脑组织时，可由有经验的团队取栓——所以要马上请卒中团队。同时吸氧（目标SpO₂ > 92%）、15分钟内测血糖、抽血查凝血、禁食直到吞咽评估（RCPCH 2017），并请血管外科看缺血的肢体；影像排除出血之前不用肝素或阿司匹林。
feedback.en: Right. Brain and vessel imaging within an hour of arrival (RCPCH 2017: CT with CTA, or MRI first if it is available within the hour; AHA/ASA 2026: MRI/MRA preferred, CT if MRI is not timely). At about six hours he is beyond the 4.5-hour window for IV thrombolysis, but the AHA/ASA 2026 guideline allows thrombectomy by experienced teams for large-vessel occlusion in children aged 6 or more within 6 hours, or up to 24 hours when imaging shows salvageable brain — so the stroke team is called now. Alongside: oxygen to SpO₂ > 92%, glucose within 15 minutes, bloods with clotting, nil by mouth until his swallow is checked (RCPCH 2017), and a vascular surgeon for the ischaemic limbs; no heparin or aspirin until imaging has excluded haemorrhage.

text.zh-CN: 他的神经缺损很重，立即静脉阿替普酶溶栓，随后做头颅影像；同时吸氧、查血糖，请血管外科看发凉的下肢
text.en: IV alteplase now because his deficit is disabling, with brain imaging straight after; oxygen, a glucose check and a vascular surgical review of the cold legs alongside

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。溶栓之前必须先做影像，排除出血、证实血管闭塞；而且他已发病约6小时，超出了RCPCH 2017和AHA/ASA 2026指南儿童推荐中4.5小时的静脉溶栓时间窗。
feedback.en: No. Imaging comes before any thrombolysis, to exclude haemorrhage and show the occlusion, and at about six hours he is outside the 4.5-hour window for IV thrombolysis in RCPCH 2017 and in the AHA/ASA 2026 paediatric recommendation.

text.zh-CN: 左上肢无脉、下肢发凉，先按急性肢体缺血立即给肝素，再在1小时内做头颅影像，同时吸氧和查血糖
text.en: Heparin now for the pulseless arm and cold legs, as acute limb ischaemia guidance advises, then brain imaging within the hour, with oxygen and a glucose check

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。ESVS 2020确实建议急性肢体缺血用肝素，但他同时有急性卒中：头颅影像排除出血之前抗凝，可能让脑梗死变成出血。先做影像，再由卒中团队、血管外科和血液科一起决定抗凝。
feedback.en: No. ESVS 2020 does advise heparin for acute limb ischaemia, but he also has an acute stroke: anticoagulation before imaging has excluded haemorrhage can turn an infarct into a bleed. Image first; the stroke team, the vascular surgeons and haematology then decide on anticoagulation together.

text.zh-CN: 已经过了治疗时间窗：收入病房，给阿司匹林5 mg/kg，吸氧并做神经系统观察，排到下一次常规MRI检查
text.en: Beyond any treatment window, so admit him to the ward with aspirin 5 mg/kg, oxygen and neurological observations, and book an MRI on the next routine list

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。6小时并不意味着所有治疗都来不及：AHA/ASA 2026指南对6岁以上大血管闭塞的儿童，24小时内影像提示有可挽救脑组织时仍可考虑取栓，影像要在1小时内完成（RCPCH 2017）。影像排除出血之前也不能给阿司匹林；病因在心脏时通常首选抗凝而不是阿司匹林（AHA/ASA 2019）。
feedback.en: No. Six hours does not close every door: the AHA/ASA 2026 guideline allows thrombectomy up to 24 hours in children aged 6 or more with large-vessel occlusion and salvageable brain on imaging, and imaging belongs in the first hour (RCPCH 2017). Aspirin is not given before imaging has excluded haemorrhage, and a cardiac cause usually calls for anticoagulation rather than aspirin (AHA/ASA 2019).

text.zh-CN: 先处理呼吸：静脉呋塞米加无创通气，等双肺情况稳定后再做头颅影像
text.en: Treat the breathing first with IV furosemide and non-invasive ventilation, and image the brain once his lungs have settled

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。他的呼吸确实需要处理（吸氧，必要时进一步支持），但不能因此推迟头颅影像——影像决定能否取栓、能否抗凝，拖得越久，可挽救的脑组织越少。肺部湿啰音的原因要靠超声心动图找。
feedback.en: No. His breathing does need treating — oxygen, and more support if needed — but not at the cost of the brain imaging, which decides on thrombectomy and anticoagulation while salvageable brain is being lost. The cause of the crackles is found by echocardiography.

prompt.zh-CN: 超声心动图：左房面房间隔及二尖瓣附近5.5 cm×3.5 cm有蒂团块，蒂约1.6 cm，舒张期部分突入二尖瓣口，轻中度反流。头颅影像：双侧多发脑异常信号，以右侧为主。这个团块下一步怎么处理？
prompt.en: Echocardiography: a pedunculated 5.5 × 3.5 cm mass on the left-atrial side of the atrial septum near the mitral valve, stalk about 1.6 cm, partly protruding into the mitral orifice in diastole, with mild-to-moderate regurgitation. Brain imaging: multiple abnormal signals on both sides, predominantly right. What is the plan for the mass?

need.zh-CN: 先在本阶段调阅超声心动图和头颅MRI及血管成像的报告。
need.en: First read the echocardiogram and the brain MRI and vascular imaging reports in this phase.

text.zh-CN: 今天就请心脏外科，目标是尽早切除；由卒中团队根据影像（出血、梗死大小）一起定体外循环的时机，等待期间观察有无梗阻，并共同决定针对血栓的抗凝
text.en: Cardiac surgery today, aiming at early excision; the stroke team sets the timing of bypass from the imaging (bleeding, infarct size), while he is watched for obstruction and anticoagulation for thrombus is decided jointly

feedback.zh-CN: 对。附着在房间隔上、带蒂、可活动并突入二尖瓣口的左房团块，一边在反复把栓子送往全身，一边可能突然堵住二尖瓣口——双肺湿啰音提示它已在阻碍左心充盈。AHA/ASA 2021二级预防指南（成人；2a类推荐，C-LD）认为卒中后切除左侧心脏肿瘤可以获益，并指出开胸手术是唯一确立的治疗；一篇2022年的综述认为心脏黏液瘤需要及时诊断和手术切除（Griborio-Guzman 2022）。体外循环需要全身肝素化，所以时机要和卒中团队根据出血和梗死大小一起定。抗凝针对的是血栓（肢体、静脉、团块表面），挡不住瘤体碎片，也不能代替切除。
feedback.en: Right. A pedunculated, mobile mass on the septum that prolapses into the mitral orifice keeps showering emboli and can suddenly block the valve — the crackles suggest it already impedes left-heart filling. The AHA/ASA 2021 secondary-prevention guideline (adults; class 2a, LOE C-LD) holds that resecting a left-sided cardiac tumour after stroke can be beneficial and that open-heart surgery is the only established treatment; a 2022 review holds that a cardiac myxoma calls for prompt diagnosis and surgical resection (Griborio-Guzman 2022). Bypass needs full heparinisation, so its timing is set with the stroke team from any haemorrhage and the size of the infarcts. Anticoagulation acts on thrombus — limbs, veins, the surface of the mass — not on tumour fragments, and does not replace excision.

text.zh-CN: 先按血栓处理：足量抗凝，两周后复查超声心动图，看团块会不会缩小，再决定要不要做手术切除；这期间让他卧床休息、继续吸氧，并密切观察呼吸和神经系统的变化
text.en: Treat it as a thrombus first: full anticoagulation and a repeat echocardiogram in two weeks to see whether it shrinks before deciding on surgery, keeping him on bed rest and oxygen meanwhile and watching his breathing and his neurology closely

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。带蒂、附着在房间隔上的团块是心脏肿瘤的典型表现，而不是血栓；抗凝挡不住瘤体碎片，等两周还要承担再次栓塞和二尖瓣口被堵的风险（AHA/ASA 2021：手术是唯一确立的治疗）。
feedback.en: No. A pedunculated mass attached to the septum has the hallmarks of a cardiac tumour rather than thrombus; anticoagulation does not stop tumour fragments, and two weeks of waiting carries the risks of further emboli and of the mitral orifice being blocked (AHA/ASA 2021: surgery is the only established treatment).

text.zh-CN: 先稳定病情，带抗凝药出院，等脑梗死恢复两三个月后再择期切除
text.en: Stabilise him, discharge him on anticoagulation, and book elective excision two or three months later once the strokes have healed

feedback.zh-CN: 不是最佳方案。体外循环要全身肝素化，大面积梗死或出血时推迟手术有其道理，但这要由卒中团队根据影像逐例判断，而不是常规等上几个月：这段时间里，可活动的团块会继续带来再次栓塞和突然堵住二尖瓣口的风险（Griborio-Guzman 2022综述认为心脏黏液瘤需要及时手术切除）。
feedback.en: Not the best plan. Bypass needs full heparinisation, and a delay can be right after a large infarct or a bleed, but that is judged case by case from the imaging with the stroke team — not a routine wait of months, during which a mobile mass keeps the risks of further emboli and of sudden obstruction of the mitral orifice (the Griborio-Guzman 2022 review holds that a cardiac myxoma calls for prompt surgical resection).

text.zh-CN: 静脉溶栓，同时溶解团块和外周的栓子，避免开胸手术
text.en: IV thrombolysis to dissolve the mass and the peripheral emboli together and avoid open-heart surgery

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。溶栓溶不掉肿瘤组织，还可能让团块碎裂成新的栓子；他有双侧多发急性脑病灶，溶栓有出血的危险（ESVS 2020把近两个月内的脑血管事件列为肢体缺血溶栓的绝对禁忌）。
feedback.en: No. Thrombolysis does not dissolve tumour tissue and may break the mass into new emboli; with multiple acute brain lesions on both sides it risks haemorrhage (ESVS 2020 lists a cerebrovascular event within two months as an absolute contraindication to thrombolysis for limb ischaemia).

text.zh-CN: 先经导管取活检，明确团块性质，再决定是否手术
text.en: A catheter biopsy of the mass to establish what it is before deciding on surgery

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。对左房内可活动的团块做导管活检，可能把碎片打成新的栓子；诊断要靠切除后的病理，影像已经足以决定手术。
feedback.en: No. Biopsying a mobile left-atrial mass by catheter can break off new emboli; the diagnosis comes from the pathology after excision, and the imaging already justifies surgery.

prompt.zh-CN: 住院第3天，他两侧小腿明显肿痛。他的下肢血管检查显示双下肢重度缺血频谱、左腘静脉及股腘动脉血栓。首先要做什么？
prompt.en: Day 3: both his calves are obviously swollen and painful. His lower-limb vascular studies showed severe ischaemic waveforms in both legs and thrombus in the left popliteal vein and the femoropopliteal artery. What comes first?

need.zh-CN: 先问问他的腿现在怎么样，或者检查他的两侧小腿。
need.en: First ask how his legs are now, or examine his calves.

text.zh-CN: 马上查两侧小腿有无骨筋膜室综合征（张力、被动牵拉痛、感觉和活动），拿不准就测压，血管外科到床旁准备切开；然后再查静脉血栓和新的闭塞
text.en: Check both calves for compartment syndrome now (tension, pain on passive stretch, sensation, movement), measuring pressures if unsure, with a vascular surgeon ready to decompress; then look for venous thrombosis and new occlusion

feedback.zh-CN: 对。肢体缺血后新出现的小腿肿痛，首先要排除骨筋膜室综合征，因为它几小时内就会造成不可逆的肌肉和神经损伤：诊断以临床检查为基础，拿不准时测骨筋膜室压力，一旦确诊尽快做四间隔切开减压，并在确诊后2小时内完成（ESVS 2020，成人下肢推荐）。左腘静脉已有血栓，静脉血栓蔓延和新的动脉栓塞随后用超声复查（ASH/ISTH 2024建议有症状的儿童深静脉血栓抗凝）。本病例没有记录当时查到了什么、做了什么。
feedback.en: Right. New calf swelling and pain after limb ischaemia means excluding compartment syndrome first, because it causes irreversible muscle and nerve damage within hours: the diagnosis is clinical, compartment pressures help when it is unclear, and a diagnosed compartment syndrome needs a four-compartment fasciotomy as soon as possible and within two hours of the diagnosis (ESVS 2020, adult lower-limb recommendations). With thrombus already in the left popliteal vein, spreading venous thrombosis and new arterial emboli are then sought by ultrasound (ASH/ISTH 2024 suggests anticoagulation for symptomatic DVT in children). What was found or done at the time is not recorded.

text.zh-CN: 最可能是双侧深静脉血栓：加大肝素剂量，明天再复查下肢超声；这期间让他多活动脚踝、多喝水，护士每班量一次两侧小腿的周径并记录，观察肿痛的变化
text.en: Bilateral deep vein thrombosis is most likely: increase the heparin dose and repeat the leg ultrasound tomorrow, meanwhile getting him to move his ankles and drink plenty, with the nurses measuring his calf circumference every shift

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。深静脉血栓确实要考虑（左腘静脉已有血栓），但先把它当成诊断、等到明天，可能漏掉几个小时就能毁掉小腿的骨筋膜室综合征；加大肝素也要权衡他的急性脑病灶。
feedback.en: No. Venous thrombosis is a real possibility — there is already thrombus in the left popliteal vein — but assuming it and waiting until tomorrow risks missing a compartment syndrome that can destroy the calf within hours, and more heparin must be weighed against his acute brain lesions.

text.zh-CN: 抬高双腿、穿弹力袜消肿，再加止痛药
text.en: Raise both legs and fit compression stockings to bring the swelling down, with simple painkillers

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。他的腿是缺血的：加压和抬高会进一步降低灌注，还会掩盖骨筋膜室综合征。NICE NG89（2018，成人指南）规定外周动脉疾病者不用抗栓弹力袜。
feedback.en: No. These legs are ischaemic: compression and elevation lower perfusion further and can mask compartment syndrome. NICE NG89 (2018, adult guidance) says anti-embolism stockings are not offered to people with peripheral arterial disease.

text.zh-CN: 缺血的肌肉恢复时肿痛是意料之中的：给止痛药，继续观察
text.en: Swelling and pain are expected while ischaemic muscle recovers: give painkillers and keep watching

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。肢体缺血之后的肿痛，正是骨筋膜室综合征的典型背景；止痛药会掩盖越来越重的疼痛，延误切开减压（ESVS 2020）。
feedback.en: No. Swelling and pain after limb ischaemia are exactly the setting of compartment syndrome; painkillers can mask escalating pain and delay a fasciotomy (ESVS 2020).

text.zh-CN: 下肢动脉导管溶栓，在肌肉坏死之前恢复血流
text.en: Catheter-directed thrombolysis of the leg arteries to restore flow before the muscle dies

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。他刚发生急性卒中，近两个月内的脑血管事件是溶栓的绝对禁忌（ESVS 2020，表5）；儿童急性肢体缺血以肝素为主，无效时由血管外科考虑手术。
feedback.en: No. He has just had an acute stroke, and a cerebrovascular event within two months is an absolute contraindication to thrombolysis (ESVS 2020, Table 5); in children, heparin is the mainstay for acute limb ischaemia, with surgery considered by the vascular team if it fails.

prompt.zh-CN: 切除的团块病理是左房黏液瘤。他以后的随访应该包括哪些？（多选）
prompt.en: The resected mass is a left atrial myxoma. What should his follow-up include? (Select all that apply.)

need.zh-CN: 先在本阶段调阅病理报告。
need.en: First read the pathology report in this phase.

text.zh-CN: 定期复查超声心动图，及早发现复发
text.en: Regular echocardiograms to catch any recurrence early

feedback.zh-CN: 对。黏液瘤切除后可以复发；Carney综合征患者大多因为复发要做不止一次心脏手术（Correa 2015），所以要定期看心脏。
feedback.en: Right. Myxomas can recur after excision, and in Carney complex most patients need more than one heart operation for recurrences (Correa 2015), so the heart is watched with regular scans.

text.zh-CN: 评估Carney综合征——看皮肤色素斑和内分泌问题——做遗传咨询，必要时检测PRKAR1A并筛查家人
text.en: Assessment for Carney complex — skin pigmentation and endocrine problems — with genetic counselling, PRKAR1A testing where appropriate and screening of relatives

feedback.zh-CN: 对。12岁就出现心脏黏液瘤并不常见，应当想到Carney综合征：它与PRKAR1A基因突变相关，常伴皮肤色素斑和内分泌肿瘤；这类患者从婴儿期起每年做超声心动图，发生过黏液瘤后复查更密（Correa 2015）。本病例没有记录他的皮肤、内分泌情况、家族史或基因检测。
feedback.en: Right. A cardiac myxoma at 12 is unusual and should raise Carney complex, linked to PRKAR1A mutations and to skin pigmentation and endocrine tumours; people with it have echocardiography every year from infancy, more often once a myxoma has occurred (Correa 2015). His skin, endocrine status, family history and genetics are not recorded.

text.zh-CN: 继续卒中康复，并随访左腿的力量和血液循环
text.en: Continued stroke rehabilitation, with follow-up of his left leg's strength and circulation

feedback.zh-CN: 对。几处动脉同时缺血之后，他需要较长时间的神经康复和肢体随访；康复目标要尽早定下来，并让家人参与。
feedback.en: Right. After ischaemia in several territories he needs ongoing neurorehabilitation and follow-up of his limbs, with goals set early and shared with his family.

text.zh-CN: 终身服用华法林，防止黏液瘤再长出来
text.en: Lifelong warfarin to stop the myxoma growing back

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。抗凝不能预防肿瘤复发；切除后如果没有其他指征，不需要长期抗凝，长期抗凝只会增加出血风险。
feedback.en: No. Anticoagulation does not prevent a tumour from recurring; after excision there is no reason for long-term anticoagulation without another indication, and it adds bleeding risk.

text.zh-CN: 良性肿瘤切除干净就等于治愈：不需要再做任何影像随访，伤口愈合后就可以恢复正常的上学和体育活动
text.en: Excision of a benign tumour means cure: no further imaging of any kind is needed, and he can return to school and sport as soon as the wound has healed

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。黏液瘤切除后仍可能复发，年轻患者和Carney综合征尤其如此，需要定期做超声心动图随访（Correa 2015）；他的卒中和肢体问题也还需要康复和随访。
feedback.en: No. Myxomas can recur after excision, particularly in the young and in Carney complex, so regular echocardiographic follow-up is needed (Correa 2015); his stroke and his limbs also need rehabilitation and follow-up.

text.zh-CN: 问清突然起病的左侧偏瘫：多久了、哪一侧、有无外伤，以及发病时呼吸急促
text.en: Established the sudden left-sided weakness — how long, which side, any injury — and the fast breathing at onset

text.zh-CN: 询问了以前的心脏情况、家族史、用药、过敏以及发病时的情形，把家属答不上来的当作未知
text.en: Asked about earlier heart problems, family history, medicines, allergies and how the onset was found, treating what the relative could not say as unknown

text.zh-CN: 检查了神经系统、四肢脉搏和皮温、两侧血压和呼吸频率，并听诊双肺
text.en: Examined the neurology, the pulses and warmth of all four limbs, the blood pressure on both sides, the breathing rate and both lungs

text.zh-CN: 首次作答即认出几处供血区域同时缺血指向左心来源的栓塞
text.en: Recognised at the first attempt that simultaneous ischaemia in several territories points to emboli from the left heart

text.zh-CN: 首次作答即定下第一个小时的方案：不溶栓，影像之前不用抗栓药
text.en: Set the first-hour plan at the first attempt, without thrombolysis and without antithrombotic drugs before imaging

text.zh-CN: 在到院阶段就申请了头颅和血管影像
text.en: Requested brain and vessel imaging during the arrival phase, before anything else could delay it

text.zh-CN: 第一个小时内呼叫了卒中团队和血管外科，给氧、测血糖、抽血查凝血，并禁食等待吞咽评估
text.en: Within the first hour called the stroke team and the vascular surgeons, gave oxygen, checked glucose, sent bloods with clotting and kept him nil by mouth pending a swallow screen

text.zh-CN: 调阅并解读了头颅MRI及血管成像、超声心动图、下肢血管检查和后续血管成像
text.en: Read and interpreted the brain MRI and vascular imaging, the echocardiogram, the lower-limb vascular studies and the later vascular imaging

text.zh-CN: 首次作答即为左房团块定下正确的处理方案
text.en: Chose the right plan for the left atrial mass at the first attempt

text.zh-CN: 读完超声心动图后、住院第3天之前就请了心脏外科
text.en: Referred him to cardiac surgery once the echocardiogram was read, before day 3

text.zh-CN: 第3天小腿肿痛时首次作答即先排查骨筋膜室综合征，并及时请血管外科床旁评估
text.en: On day 3 put compartment syndrome first at the first attempt and had the calves assessed at the bedside in time

text.zh-CN: 首次作答即定下黏液瘤切除后的随访，并安排了超声心动图复查和遗传学评估
text.en: Planned the follow-up after the myxoma at the first attempt and arranged echocardiographic surveillance and a genetics referral

text.zh-CN: 没有在时间窗外溶栓、没有在排除出血前抗凝、没有在卒中后做下肢溶栓，也没有给缺血的腿加压
text.en: Avoided thrombolysis outside its window, anticoagulation before haemorrhage was excluded, leg thrombolysis after a stroke and compression of ischaemic legs

text.zh-CN: 用孩子和家属听得懂的话解释病情、不确定之处和接下来的安排
text.en: Explained the situation, the uncertainties and the next steps in words the boy and his relative could follow

judgeGuidance.zh-CN: 良好表现（Calgary–Cambridge：开始接诊、收集信息、解释与计划、结束）：向孩子和家属自我介绍，先了解家属看到了什么、最担心什么；按孩子的年龄让他参与，用几个字就能回答的问题问他自己的感受。坏消息用SPIKES：先确认家属已经知道的，再分几步、用通俗的话说明——这是卒中，同时腿和左手的血管也被堵住了，原因很可能在心脏里，需要马上做影像和请几个专科；不承诺手脚一定能恢复，也不编造病例没有的结果。说清为什么现在不能用溶栓药、为什么抗凝要等脑部影像、为什么心脏里的团块要请心脏外科、手术时机由几个团队一起定；第3天小腿肿痛时说明要立即排查的危险。坦白哪些情况病例里不知道（以前的心脏情况、家族史、药物和过敏），并请家属回忆。用复述（teach-back）确认家属理解，留出提问时间。
judgeGuidance.en: Good performance (Calgary–Cambridge: initiating, gathering information, explaining and planning, closing): introduces themselves to the boy and his relative and first finds out what the relative saw and fears most; involves the boy as fits a 12-year-old, asking him about what he feels in questions he can answer in a few words. Breaks the bad news with SPIKES: checks what the relative already knows, then explains in plain steps that this is a stroke, that arteries to his legs and left arm are blocked too, that the cause is probably in the heart, and that imaging and several specialists are needed now — without promising recovery and without inventing results the case does not hold. Explains why a clot-busting drug cannot be used now, why blood thinners wait for the brain scan, why the mass in the heart means calling the heart surgeons, and that the teams set the timing of surgery together; on day 3, explains the danger that the swollen calves must be checked for at once. Is honest about what is unknown (earlier heart problems, family history, medicines, allergies) and asks the relative to think back. Uses teach-back to check understanding and leaves time for questions.

knowledge.zh-CN: 到院交班（ISBAR）——身份：金知远，12岁，由家属陪同。现状：大约6小时前左边胳膊和腿突然不能动。背景：发病前没有受伤；以前的身体情况、用药和过敏都不清楚。评估：呼吸40次/分，双肺湿啰音；左桡动脉摸不到，双侧股动脉搏动差，下肢发凉；右侧血压110/70 mmHg，左侧测不出；左侧面舌瘫，左上下肢不能动。建议：请马上来看——像是卒中，四肢的血供也有问题。她知道东西在哪里：监护仪、吸氧装置和置管车就在床旁，病历终端在护士站；MRI和CT在影像科，超声心动图机和超声可以推到床旁。每条医嘱她都复述确认，负责护理工作（监测、禁食、吸氧），不说病例没有记录的任何结果。
knowledge.en: Handover on arrival (ISBAR) — Identify: Jin Zhiyuan, 12, with a relative. Situation: his left arm and leg suddenly stopped moving about six hours ago. Background: no injury beforehand; his past health, medicines and allergies are not known. Assessment: breathing at 40/min with crackles over both lungs; no left radial pulse, poor femoral pulses, cool legs; blood pressure 110/70 mmHg on the right and unmeasurable on the left; left facial and tongue weakness, no movement in the left arm and leg. Recommendation: please see him now — this looks like a stroke, and his limbs are not getting enough blood. She knows where things are: the monitor, oxygen and the cannulation trolley at the bed, the records terminal at the nurses' station, MRI and CT in imaging, the echo machine and ultrasound brought to the bedside. She reads every order back, carries out nursing care (observations, nil by mouth, oxygen) and gives no result the case does not record.

knowledge.zh-CN: 苏格拉底式带教、按PEARLS复盘，只围绕学员已经掌握的信息提问，例如：“同时有三个供血区域缺血，什么样的过程能一次做到？”“发病6小时，排除了哪种治疗，又没有排除哪种？”“这里有两份指南对肝素的说法相反，哪一个先说了算？”“一个突入二尖瓣口的有蒂团块，在手术之前会做什么？”“肢体缺血后小腿又肿又痛，接下来一小时里你最怕漏掉什么？”“对这个孩子，抗凝能治什么，碰不到什么？”“报告记录的经过和你今天的做法有什么不同？”。她了解RCPCH 2017、AHA/ASA 2026与2019、AHA/ASA 2021、ESVS 2020、ASH/ISTH 2024和Correa 2015的相关内容；在学员读到之前，不说出诊断、病理和结局，也不补充病例没有记录的事实。
knowledge.en: A Socratic preceptor who debriefs with PEARLS and asks only about what the learner already has, for example: “Three territories at once — what single process does that?”, “What does six hours rule out, and what does it not?”, “Two guidelines pull opposite ways on heparin here — which one speaks first?”, “What will a pedunculated mass that prolapses into the mitral valve do before the operation?”, “Swollen, painful calves after limb ischaemia — what must you not miss in the next hour?”, “In this boy, what does anticoagulation treat, and what can it not touch?”, “How does the recorded course differ from what you would do today?”. She knows the relevant parts of RCPCH 2017, AHA/ASA 2026 and 2019, AHA/ASA 2021, ESVS 2020, ASH/ISTH 2024 and Correa 2015; she names no diagnosis, pathology or outcome before the learner has read it, and adds no fact the case does not record.

knowledge.zh-CN: 心脏外科医生。只在学员读过相应报告之后解读超声心动图、病理和随访记录：一个附着在房间隔上、带蒂、舒张期突入二尖瓣口的左房团块意味着什么（反复栓塞、突然堵住二尖瓣口）；切除这类团块需要体外循环，而体外循环要全身肝素化，所以手术时机要和卒中团队根据有无出血和梗死大小一起定；AHA/ASA 2021指南认为卒中后切除左侧心脏肿瘤可以获益，开胸手术是唯一确立的治疗。本病例没有记录手术日期以外的手术细节（入路、所见、切缘），她不补充。
knowledge.en: Cardiac surgeon. Interprets the echocardiogram, the pathology and the follow-up record only once the learner has read them: what a pedunculated left-atrial mass attached to the septum and prolapsing into the mitral orifice in diastole implies (repeated emboli, sudden blockage of the mitral orifice); that removing it needs cardiopulmonary bypass with full heparinisation, so the timing is agreed with the stroke team from any haemorrhage and the size of the infarcts; and that the AHA/ASA 2021 guideline holds resection of a left-sided cardiac tumour after stroke beneficial, with open-heart surgery the only established treatment. The case records no detail of the operation beyond its timing (approach, findings, margins), and she adds none.

knowledge.zh-CN: 血管外科医生。只在学员读过相应报告之后解读下肢血管检查和后续血管成像。她按ESVS 2020的思路讲：儿童急性肢体缺血以肝素为主（但这个孩子要等头颅影像排除出血），保守治疗无效时才考虑溶栓或手术，而近两个月内的脑血管事件是溶栓的绝对禁忌；肢体缺血后小腿肿痛要先排除骨筋膜室综合征——临床检查、拿不准时测压、确诊后2小时内切开减压；缺血的腿不能加压。本病例没有记录她或其他人对他的四肢做过什么检查和处理，她不补充。
knowledge.en: Vascular surgeon. Interprets the lower-limb vascular studies and the later vascular imaging only once the learner has read them. She reasons along ESVS 2020: in children, heparin is the mainstay for acute limb ischaemia (in this boy only once brain imaging has excluded haemorrhage), thrombolysis or surgery come in only when that fails, and a cerebrovascular event within two months is an absolute contraindication to thrombolysis; swollen, painful calves after limb ischaemia are compartment syndrome until shown otherwise — clinical examination, pressures if unsure, fasciotomy within two hours of the diagnosis; ischaemic legs are never compressed. The case records no examination or treatment of his limbs by her or anyone else, and she adds none.

title.zh-CN: 复盘：一次发病，多处动脉——从第一个小时到切除之后
title.en: Debrief: one onset, many arteries — from the first hour to after the excision

conclusion.zh-CN: 12岁男孩突发左侧肢体瘫痪约6小时就诊，发病前没有外伤，发病时呼吸很急。查体：左侧中枢性面舌瘫，左上下肢肌力0级，Babinski征阳性；呼吸40次/分，双肺广泛湿啰音；左桡动脉未触及，双侧股动脉搏动差，下肢皮温低；右侧血压110/70 mmHg，左侧测不出。头颅MRI及血管成像示双侧多发脑异常信号（右侧为主）、右大脑中动脉中远段狭窄闭塞和左锁骨下动脉闭塞；下肢血管检查示双下肢重度缺血频谱、左腘静脉及股腘动脉血栓，后续血管成像见多处动脉闭塞；超声心动图示左房面房间隔及二尖瓣附近5.5 cm×3.5 cm有蒂团块，舒张期部分突入二尖瓣口。住院第3天双侧小腿明显肿痛。他先接受支持、抗凝等治疗，住院40天后出院，约1个月后切除左房肿物，病理为左房黏液瘤。此后左上肢恢复，左下肢肌力近端Ⅴ-级、远端Ⅲ级，超声未见复发。按今天的做法：1小时内完成脑和血管影像并请卒中团队（6小时已不能溶栓，但仍可评估取栓），排除出血后再抗凝，当天请心脏外科、由卒中团队定手术时机，小腿肿痛先排查骨筋膜室综合征，切除后随访复发并评估Carney综合征。
conclusion.en: A 12-year-old boy presented about six hours after the sudden onset of left-sided paralysis, with no injury beforehand and very fast breathing at onset. He had a left central facial and tongue palsy, power grade 0 in the left arm and leg and a positive Babinski sign; a respiratory rate of 40/min with widespread crackles over both lungs; no palpable left radial pulse, poor femoral pulses on both sides and cool legs; and a blood pressure of 110/70 mmHg on the right that could not be measured on the left. Brain MRI and vascular imaging showed multiple abnormal signals on both sides, predominantly right, with mid-to-distal right middle cerebral artery stenosis/occlusion and left subclavian occlusion; the lower-limb studies showed severe ischaemic waveforms in both legs and thrombus in the left popliteal vein and the femoropopliteal artery, and later imaging multiple arterial occlusions. Echocardiography found a pedunculated 5.5 × 3.5 cm mass on the left-atrial side of the septum near the mitral valve, partly prolapsing into the mitral orifice in diastole. On day 3 both calves were obviously swollen and painful. He was given supportive and anticoagulant treatment, among others, first, was discharged after 40 days in hospital, and the mass was resected about a month later: left atrial myxoma. His left arm recovered; left-leg power was V− proximally and III distally; ultrasound showed no recurrence. Today: brain and vessel imaging within the hour with the stroke team called (too late for thrombolysis at six hours, not for a thrombectomy assessment), anticoagulation once haemorrhage is excluded, cardiac surgery the same day with the timing set by the brain, compartment syndrome first when the calves swell, and follow-up for recurrence with an assessment for Carney complex.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 右侧大脑半球、左上肢和双下肢同时缺血，又是突然起病：在证明不是之前，按同一来源的栓塞处理，先去左心找来源。
keyReasoning.en: The right hemisphere, the left arm and both legs ischaemic at once, with a sudden onset: emboli from a single source until proven otherwise, and the left heart is the first place to look.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 发病6小时关上的是静脉溶栓的门，不是取栓的门：所以第一小时的任务是尽快做脑和血管影像、把卒中团队叫来，而不是先处理其他器官。
keyReasoning.en: Six hours closes the door on IV thrombolysis but not on thrombectomy, so the first hour's job is fast brain and vessel imaging with the stroke team on the phone — not treating another organ first.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 肢体需要肝素，但脑可能出血：两个器官各自的指南互相冲突时，先做能排除出血的影像，再由几个团队一起决定。
keyReasoning.en: The limbs want heparin, the brain may bleed: when each organ's guidance pulls a different way, the imaging that excludes haemorrhage comes first and the teams decide together.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 突入二尖瓣口的有蒂团块同时解释了栓塞和肺部湿啰音；抗凝只能管血栓，挡不住瘤体碎片，只有切除才能去掉来源，而时机取决于脑。
keyReasoning.en: A pedunculated mass prolapsing into the mitral orifice explains both the emboli and the crackles; anticoagulation only touches thrombus, not tumour fragments, so only excision removes the source — at a time the brain allows.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 缺血肢体在第3天又肿又痛：先当骨筋膜室综合征处理，因为它几小时就能毁掉小腿；已知的腘静脉血栓是第二个、较慢的问题。
keyReasoning.en: Ischaemic legs that swell and hurt on day 3 are compartment syndrome until shown otherwise, because it can destroy the calf within hours; the known popliteal vein thrombus is a second, slower problem.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 儿童卒中的第一个小时。RCPCH 2017：到院1小时内做头颅CT加CT血管成像（主动脉弓至颅顶），1小时内能做MRI时可首选MRI；吸氧使SpO₂ > 92%，15分钟内测血糖，吞咽安全前禁食。AHA/ASA 2026：首选MRI/MRA，不能及时做时用CT。当年与现在：报告记录了头颅MRI及血管成像，但没有记录时间，第一小时做得怎样无从判断。
teachingPoints.en: The first hour of childhood stroke. RCPCH 2017: CT with CT angiography from the aortic arch to the vertex within one hour of arrival, or MRI first if it is available within that hour; oxygen to SpO₂ > 92%, glucose within 15 minutes, nil by mouth until the swallow is safe. AHA/ASA 2026: MRI/MRA preferred, CT if MRI is not timely. Then and now: the report records brain MRI and vascular imaging but not when, so the first hour cannot be judged.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 儿童的超急性期治疗——AHA/ASA 2026指南首次给出儿童推荐：28天至18岁、致残性缺损、4.5小时内可考虑静脉阿替普酶；6岁以上大血管闭塞，由有经验的神经介入医生在6小时内、或24小时内影像提示有可挽救脑组织时取栓。他到院时约6小时，已不能溶栓；取栓证据最强的是颅内颈内动脉或大脑中动脉M1段这样的近端闭塞，中远段闭塞要由卒中团队逐例判断。当年与现在：这些推荐晚于报告发表，病例也没有记录任何超急性期治疗。
teachingPoints.en: Hyperacute treatment in children — the AHA/ASA 2026 guideline's first recommendations for children: IV alteplase may be considered within 4.5 hours for disabling deficits from 28 days to 18 years; thrombectomy by experienced neurointerventionalists for large-vessel occlusion at 6 years or older within 6 hours, or up to 24 hours with salvageable brain on imaging. At about six hours he was beyond thrombolysis; the evidence for thrombectomy is strongest in proximal occlusions such as the intracranial carotid or the M1 segment, so a mid-to-distal MCA occlusion is a case-by-case call for the stroke team. Then and now: these recommendations postdate the report, and no hyperacute treatment is recorded.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 抗栓治疗与器官之间的冲突。AHA/ASA 2019声明：心源性卒中患儿通常首选抗凝，很大的急性梗死是相对禁忌；RCPCH 2017：病因在心脏时，由血液科、神经科和心脏科共同在抗血小板与抗凝之间选择；ESVS 2020：急性肢体缺血用肝素，在儿童是主要治疗。先用影像排除出血，再抗凝治疗血栓——同时明白肿瘤来源的栓子可以是血栓，也可以是瘤体碎片（AHA/ASA 2021），抗凝只对前者起作用。当年与现在：报告记录了抗凝等治疗，没有记录药物、剂量和开始时间。
teachingPoints.en: Antithrombotic choice and the conflict between organs. AHA/ASA 2019 statement: anticoagulation is usually preferred for cardioembolic stroke in children, with very large acute infarcts a relative contraindication; RCPCH 2017: when the cause is cardiac, haematology, neurology and cardiology choose between antiplatelet and anticoagulant together; ESVS 2020: heparin for acute limb ischaemia, the mainstay in children. Imaging excludes haemorrhage first, then anticoagulation treats thrombus — knowing that emboli from a tumour may be thrombus or tumour fragments (AHA/ASA 2021), and anticoagulation acts only on the first. Then and now: the report records anticoagulant treatment, not the drug, dose or start.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 卒中后的心脏肿瘤。AHA/ASA 2021二级预防指南（成人；2a类推荐，C-LD）：卒中或TIA后发现左侧心脏肿瘤，切除可以获益，开胸手术是唯一确立的治疗；一篇2022年的综述认为心脏黏液瘤需要及时诊断和手术切除（Griborio-Guzman 2022）。体外循环需要全身肝素化，时机由心脏外科和卒中团队根据出血与梗死大小一起定。当年与现在：他住院40天后出院、约1个月后才切除团块——今天这样长的间隔需要写明理由。
teachingPoints.en: A cardiac tumour after stroke. AHA/ASA 2021 secondary-prevention guideline (adults; class 2a, LOE C-LD): when stroke or TIA reveals a left-sided cardiac tumour, resection can be beneficial, and open-heart surgery is the only established treatment; a 2022 review holds that a cardiac myxoma calls for prompt diagnosis and surgical resection (Griborio-Guzman 2022). Bypass needs full heparinisation, so the cardiac surgeons and the stroke team set the timing from any haemorrhage and the size of the infarcts. Then and now: he was discharged after 40 days and the mass was resected about a month later — an interval that today would need a documented reason.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 先想到骨筋膜室综合征（ESVS 2020，成人下肢推荐）：以临床检查诊断，拿不准时测压，一旦确诊尽快做四间隔切开减压，并在确诊后2小时内完成；缺血的腿不加压（NICE NG89 2018，成人指南）。当年与现在：报告记录了第3天双侧小腿明显肿痛，但没有记录查到了什么、做了什么；随访时他的左下肢远端肌力为Ⅲ级。
teachingPoints.en: Compartment syndrome first (ESVS 2020, adult lower-limb recommendations): a clinical diagnosis, pressures when unclear, a four-compartment fasciotomy as soon as possible and within two hours of the diagnosis, and no compression of ischaemic legs (NICE NG89 2018, adult guidance). Then and now: the report records both calves obviously swollen and painful on day 3 but not what was found or done; at follow-up his left-leg distal power was grade III.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 黏液瘤切除之后（Correa 2015）：黏液瘤会复发，Carney综合征（与PRKAR1A相关）患者大多要再次手术；这类患者从婴儿期起每年做超声心动图，发生过黏液瘤后复查更密。儿童出现黏液瘤，应评估Carney综合征并做遗传咨询。当年与现在：报告记录超声未见复发，但没有记录随访多久，也没有记录是否评估过Carney综合征。
teachingPoints.en: After a myxoma (Correa 2015): myxomas recur, and most people with Carney complex (linked to PRKAR1A) need further surgery; they have echocardiography every year from infancy and more often after a myxoma. A child with a myxoma deserves an assessment for Carney complex and genetic counselling. Then and now: the report records no recurrence on ultrasound, but not how long he was followed or whether Carney complex was looked for.

boundaries.zh-CN: 单篇病例报告，依据1.0.0版提取的事实改编，尚未对照原文全文核对。它不能说明哪项治疗带来了他的恢复，也不能说明推迟手术是否安全。生命体征（呼吸和血压以外）、化验、影像细节和时间、药物和剂量、手术细节和随访时长都没有记录；决策、处置选项和评分是教学设计，不改变记录的病程。
boundaries.en: A single case report, re-authored from the facts extracted for version 1.0.0 and not yet checked against the full article. It cannot show which treatment brought about his recovery, nor whether operating later was safe. Vital signs beyond the breathing rate and blood pressure, laboratory results, the detail and timing of the imaging, the drugs and doses, the operation and the length of follow-up are not recorded; the decisions, intervention options and scoring are teaching design and do not change the recorded course.

unknowns.zh-CN: 呼吸频率和双侧血压以外的生命体征（心率、血氧饱和度、体温）、意识水平、PedNIHSS评分，以及言语、语言和吞咽情况。
unknowns.en: Vital signs other than the respiratory rate and the two blood pressures (heart rate, oxygen saturation, temperature), his conscious level, a PedNIHSS score, and his speech, language and swallowing.

unknowns.zh-CN: 所有化验结果（血糖、血常规、凝血、生化、炎症指标、肌酸激酶）、心电图和胸片。
unknowns.en: Every laboratory result (glucose, blood count, clotting, chemistry, inflammatory markers, creatine kinase), the ECG and a chest X-ray.

unknowns.zh-CN: 各项影像的时间和细节：MRI序列、有无出血、病灶大小，血管成像的方法和范围，下肢血管检查的方法与日期，后续血管成像涉及哪些动脉，股腘动脉血栓的侧别，以及Babinski征的侧别。
unknowns.en: The timing and detail of the imaging: MRI sequences, any haemorrhage, lesion size, the method and extent of the vascular imaging, the method and date of the lower-limb studies, which arteries the later imaging involved, the side of the femoropopliteal arterial thrombus, and the side of the Babinski sign.

unknowns.zh-CN: 治疗细节：抗栓药物、剂量、开始时间和监测，“支持治疗”的内容，有没有对四肢做过处理，第3天小腿肿痛查到了什么、做了什么，手术推迟到出院后的理由，以及手术的日期和方式。
unknowns.en: The treatment in detail: the antithrombotic drug, dose, start and monitoring, what the supportive treatment was, any treatment of the limbs, what was found or done for the calves on day 3, the reasons for operating after discharge, and the date and approach of the operation.

unknowns.zh-CN: 超声心动图上团块以外的情况：哪个瓣膜反流、左房大小、心室功能和肺动脉压。
unknowns.en: The echocardiogram beyond the mass: which valve regurgitated, the left atrial size, ventricular function and pulmonary pressure.

unknowns.zh-CN: 病史：以前的心脏情况、既往疾病和手术、用药、过敏、家族史、疫苗、发育和上学情况、发病时有没有人在场、有没有抽搐或头痛，以及皮肤表现、是否评估过Carney综合征和遗传学检测。
unknowns.en: The history: earlier heart problems, past illnesses and operations, medicines, allergies, family history, vaccinations, development and schooling, whether anyone saw the onset, any fit or headache, and his skin, any assessment for Carney complex and any genetic testing.

unknowns.zh-CN: 各处栓塞物的组织成分、出院时的神经功能、随访时长和远期是否复发。
unknowns.en: The tissue composition of the individual emboli, his neurological state at discharge, the length of follow-up and any later recurrence.

unknowns.zh-CN: 超声心动图上团块以外的情况：哪个瓣膜反流、左房大小、心室功能和肺动脉压。
unknowns.en: The echocardiogram beyond the mass: which valve regurgitated, the left atrial size, ventricular function and pulmonary pressure.

unknowns.zh-CN: 病史：以前的心脏情况、既往疾病和手术、用药、过敏、家族史、疫苗、发育和上学情况、发病时有没有人在场、有没有抽搐或头痛，以及皮肤表现、是否评估过Carney综合征和遗传学检测。
unknowns.en: The history: earlier heart problems, past illnesses and operations, medicines, allergies, family history, vaccinations, development and schooling, whether anyone saw the onset, any fit or headache, and his skin, any assessment for Carney complex and any genetic testing.

unknowns.zh-CN: 各处栓塞物的组织成分、出院时的神经功能、随访时长和远期是否复发。
unknowns.en: The tissue composition of the individual emboli, his neurological state at discharge, the length of follow-up and any later recurrence.
